desc:
Secure the Waterpark! 🚨

🔍 Scan guests for hidden weapons
🔫 Find shanks, guns, and other illegal weapons
🛟 Save guests from drowning
🤑 Earn cash and upgrade your lifeguard & security gear
🎢 Unlock bigger and crazier areas of the waterpark [SOON]
⚠️ Stop criminals from sneaking in at night

🔥 The longer your shift lasts, the crazier the waterpark gets!

😡 Deal with crazy guests causing chaos!
🌊 Stop the final beach boss and secure the waterpark
🏆 Unlock exclusive rewards and achievements

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

👑 Can you become the ULTIMATE Lifeguard?
